findings.message: Template loader loads from data/templates/*.json (not hardcoded)
create_project_from_template parses JSON and creates Project/World/SceneNode/GameRule
PluginSDK enforces declared ports via can_access_port()
PluginSDK enforces declared tools via can_register_tool()
PluginManifest supports HMAC-SHA256 signing with ManifestSignature
Comprehensive test coverage for both template loader and plugin SDK
Template files exist for adventure, city, farm, obby, tycoon
